run_flux_kontext_inpaint_pipeline: run the FluxKontextInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image with a text prompt and mask
run_flux_kontext_inpaint_with_reference: run the FluxKontextInpaintPipeline inpainting with an image reference for conditioned generation
